implement.name: Semantic element over ARIA role
implement.summary: An interactive component implemented as a non-semantic element with a role attribute fails when a native HTML element carries the same contract for free

implement.name: Element follows the purpose
implement.summary: An interactive widget styled to look like a button must use the element that matches its purpose, not its appearance

implement.name: Tests query by accessibility role
implement.summary: When vitest is present, tests should query through getByRole, getByLabelText or getByText rather than data-testid or CSS-class selectors

review.name: HTML, CSS and accessibility refusals
review.summary: A non-semantic element with a role, a styled widget that ignores the element matching its purpose, and tests that query the wrong layer
